profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary:
Junior at Claremont McKenna College studying Computer Science and Economics.
Throughout my experiences, I have developed skills in marketing, web development, software development, data analytics and research. I am currently looking for internship opportunities in marketing, data analytics, and software development.

positions.title: Student Director of Outreach
positions.description:
•	Collaborate with the Deans of Admission to execute the Fall and Spring Diversity Preview Programs aimed at recruiting students from underrepresented backgrounds
•	Oversaw over 20 of students over 2 weekends by organizing travel, matching high school students to current students, organizing panels, and managing engaging projects for students

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Developing blogs, social media content, and promotional videos for clients in order to increase their customer base and increase outreach and awareness of title insurance
•	Performing research on title insurance and marketing strategies implemented by different companies in order to accurately develop strategies for clients and build relationships with them

positions.title: Remote Development Intern
positions.description:
•Storyboarding with the CEO develop a crowdfunding video that will increase donors and allow the start-up to expand further in the marketplace as we prepare a new platform for launch
•Formulate several ways in which the start-up could use its available resources to update their marketing strategy and publish new content in order to attract more customers
•Creating and editing content videos to include in marketing campaigns, including social media

positions.title: Marketing and Developent Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed social media marketing strategy for the Foundation by researching trends of 45+ similar organizations and using the data to increase visibility and attract at least 10 new donors
•	Collaborated with team to develop a plan for the next financial steps the organization should take to increase financial security continue to provide grants for cancer research 
•	Explored the relationship between Synterra Capital Management and the Foundation: how one funds the other, how technology has benefited both companies and the role of technology in finance

positions.title: Engineering Essentials Program Fellow
positions.description:
-Collaborated with Engineering students on case studies and developing a stock visualization app to develop technical skills 
-Connected with several engineers at the firm and gained insight to working in the technology division for large corporations

positions.title: LACAC Intern
positions.description:
-Intern and head of registration for the NALIP Media Summit
-Learning about the film industry and how it functions
-Working to promote diversity in Hollywood through programming that empowers Latinos in the entertainment industry

company.name: NALIP - The National Association of Latino Independent Producers

positions.title: Construction Assistant
positions.description:
•	Mastered cleaning in all forms as a worker and improved my skills as an assistant to a contractor.
•	Resolved questions and issues between workers that spoke different languages or were having disputes over certain contracts or work terms.

positions.title: Law Intern
positions.description:
•	Intern managing multiple tasks, including filling out forms, taking calls, and drafting translations.
•	Trained with various attorneys over immigration law and mentored in the district courts.
•	Developed social skills dealing with clients and learned to use basic systems to fill out forms and making appointment for customers.

projects.title: Calendar Application
projects.description:
•	Developing interactive application through React and JavaScript that will automate suggestions based on acquired data and habits in your calendar, such as amount of time sleeping and homework time
•	Collaborating with 2 teammates in developing back-end, front-end and product management experience

projects.title: Mi Gente Web Page
projects.description:
•	Developing interactive website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for 50+ campus users who are part of the Latinx group on campus in order to provide information about events
•	Creating application that will use data to provide job information and opportunities to club members
